Portfolio Boarding Pass

Motionby @cameronmoll2026-08-28inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Portfolio entry gate: a boarding pass slides through a scanner slot (display flips READY -> READING with amber light), the pass tilts during the swipe, and on success the gate dissolves into the portfolio (airplane-window photo + experience timeline).

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Gate screen: boarding pass (MIKE BARTON, MAN -> SEA, seat/barcode) floating above a grey scanner device with a dot-matrix 'READY' display and round LED; 'Swipe boarding pass to enter'.
20-35%
Pass drags/animates down through the scanner slot, tilting ~8deg as it feeds; display flickers.
35-50%
Display switches to 'READING' in amber with the LED lit yellow; scan progress implied; pass completes the swipe.
50-70%
Success: gate elements part/fade; the portfolio's identity block resolves (name, Manchester NH, coordinates) with an airplane-window photo.
70-100%
Portfolio scrolls: bio, experience timeline entries (Studio, Fueled, Matter Neuroscience, Contact) with roles and descriptions, year markers along a vertical rail.

Mechanics

trigger
drag/swipe the pass through the slot (or autoplay)
elements
boarding pass card, scanner (display + LED), portfolio content behind
properties
pass translateY + rotate, display text/color, LED state, gate-to-content crossfade
timing
swipe ~800ms; reading state ~1s; reveal ~600ms
easing
swipe ease-in with slight overshoot tilt; reveal ease-out
loop
one-shot gate (demo loops)

Build prompt

Build a boarding-pass entry gate. Gate: a realistic boarding pass (name, route MAN->SEA, times, seat, barcode strip) resting above a scanner device (grey rounded bar, inset slot, dot-matrix display reading 'READY' in amber 5x7 dots, round LED off). Interaction: drag the pass down through the slot (or autoplay after 2s idle) - pass translateY 1:1 with pointer plus rotate to 8deg mid-swipe, then snap through. While the pass crosses the slot: display flickers to 'READING', LED glows amber, a thin scan line sweeps the pass. Complete: green LED blink, then the gate crossfades (600ms) to the portfolio: centered identity (small-caps name, city, coordinates), airplane-window photo, and a scrollable experience timeline with year markers on a vertical rail, company wordmarks, roles, and 2-line descriptions. Reduced motion: skip tilt, simple fade.
Source: inspora.design - original interaction by @cameronmoll. Teardown snapshot Sep 2026.
